message.breachprotocol.breach.subtitle: %s has breached containment
message.breachprotocol.breach.chat: %s breached containment near %s, %s, %s. All personnel evacuate.
item.breachprotocol.fruit_of_life: Fruit of the Tree of Life
item.breachprotocol.fruit_of_knowledge: Fruit of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil
dialogue.foundation.civilian.facility: What do people say about the facility?
dialogue.foundation.staff.facility: What do people say about the facility?
dialogue.foundation.staff.cover: It was a gas leak. Nothing to worry about.
dialogue.foundation.director.facility: What do people say about the facility?
dialogue.foundation.director.cover: It was a gas leak. Nothing to worry about.
dialogue.foundation.director.informant: Keep your eyes open for us.
dialogue.foundation.boss.dayoff: Take the rest of the day off.
dialogue.foundation.applicant.breach: Something gets out on your shift. What do you do?
dialogue.foundation.applicant_hire.breac: Something gets out on your shift. What do you do?
dialogue.foundation.applicant_hire.rejec: Thank you. That will be all.
dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: I saw something near the fields last week. I've decided it was a deer. A very tall deer. Standing up.
dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/2: Do you ever see something, and your mind just... refuses it? I had that on Tuesday. I'm fine now.
dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/3: Something walked past my window at night. It didn't make a sound. I'm sleeping at my sister's for a while.
dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/4: Probably nothing. Probably. But if you go out past the old path, don't go alone.
dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/5: I told my husband what I saw. He laughed. Then he went quiet and asked me not to tell anyone else.
crabby.dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: I saw what I saw. Nobody in this village wants to hear it, so I'm telling you, %1$s.
gloomy.dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: It's always the quiet nights. Something was out there. Something is always out there.
odd.dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: There's a thing out by the river that I've named Gerald. Gerald doesn't blink. Nice enough, though.
anxious.dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: I keep thinking about what I saw. I can't sleep. Do you think I imagined it? Please say yes.
upbeat.dialogue.chat.foundation_saw/1: You'll never guess what I saw! Actually, you probably will. You've got that face. You know about it, don't you?
dialogue.chat.foundation_cover/1: There was a gas leak, apparently. Explains the headaches. And the... other thing.
dialogue.chat.foundation_cover/2: Men in white suits came round about the gas leak. Very polite. Very thorough. I feel much better now.
dialogue.chat.foundation_cover/3: Gas leak. That's what it was. Everyone agrees it was a gas leak.
crabby.dialogue.chat.foundation_cover/1: A 'gas leak'. Sure. And the moon's a lamp. I'm not stupid, %1$s.
dialogue.chat.foundation_amnesia/1: Strange week. I've lost a whole Tuesday. I found a note in my own handwriting that says 'don't ask'.
dialogue.chat.foundation_amnesia/2: I keep walking into rooms and forgetting why. More than usual, I mean.
dialogue.chat.foundation_amnesia/3: Did we talk yesterday? I feel like we talked yesterday. I can't remember a word of it.
dialogue.chat.foundation_amnesia/4: I had the nicest drink with someone from the facility. Can't remember their face. Odd.
dialogue.chat.foundation_lights/1: The lights up at the facility were on all night again. What do they do up there?
dialogue.chat.foundation_lights/2: Sirens from the hill last night. Three short, one long. My grandmother says that means 'stay inside'.
dialogue.chat.foundation_lights/3: The trucks came through at three in the morning. No markings. Never any markings.
dialogue.chat.foundation_lights/4: Someone in the tavern said the facility makes medicine. Nobody's ever been ill enough to get any.
sensitive.dialogue.chat.foundation_light: I like watching the facility lights from the hill. Something about it feels... important.
crabby.dialogue.chat.foundation_lights/1: If they're making medicine up there, why do they need so many guns?
dialogue.chat.foundation_work/1: Work's strange. Good, but strange. I've signed more forms in a week than in my whole life.
dialogue.chat.foundation_work/2: My family thinks I sort parcels. I let them.
dialogue.chat.foundation_work/3: There's a door on my floor nobody opens. Nobody even looks at it. I've started not looking at it too.
dialogue.chat.foundation_work/4: They gave me a badge. It has my picture on it and a number. I'm a number now. A well-paid number.
upbeat.dialogue.chat.foundation_work/1: Best job I've ever had. Don't tell the village. They'd only ask questions.
gloomy.dialogue.chat.foundation_work/1: The work's fine. It's the screaming through the vents I could do without.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_attack/1: Armed men came through two nights ago, asking about the facility. Not soldiers. Worse, I think.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_attack/2: Someone fired guns up on the hill. The facility people say it was a drill. Drills don't leave blood on the fence.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_attack/3: Strangers in grey camped by the river. Gone the next morning. So was the ferryman.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_site/1: They say the facility goes down further than it goes up.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_site/2: My cousin applied for a job up there. Got it. Hasn't been home since. Sends money, though.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_site/3: There's a rumour that they keep a statue up there that moves when you're not looking. Silly, isn't it?
dialogue.rumors.foundation_site/4: The facility people never get sick. Ever. Have you noticed that?
dialogue.rumors.foundation_site/5: Someone saw a man walk out of the facility gate and then walk in again. Same man. Same time.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_saw/1: Old Tam swears he saw something walking the treeline at night. Everyone laughs at Tam. I've stopped laughing.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_saw/2: The miller's daughter saw a thing by the well and hasn't spoken since. They took her up the hill to 'help'.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_saw/3: Something's been killing the sheep. Nothing we can track.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_gap/1: Half the village woke up with headaches last week. Nobody can remember Wednesday. Funny thing.
dialogue.rumors.foundation_gap/2: There was something in the well water, people say. Everyone's very calm now. Very calm.
dialogue.foundation.re.facility.plant: It's just a plant. Very boring work.
dialogue.foundation.re.facility.careful: Best not to go near it.
dialogue.foundation.re.suspicious.thanks: Thank you. Tell me if they come back.
dialogue.foundation.re.cover.sure: Completely safe. You have my word.
dialogue.foundation.re.cover.headache: If the headaches continue, see a doctor.
dialogue.foundation.re.amnestic.weather: You were telling me about the weather.
dialogue.foundation.re.amnestic.rest: You look tired. Get some rest.
dialogue.foundation.re.informant.careful: And don't go looking for trouble.
dialogue.foundation.re.job.pay: The pay is good. The questions are few.
dialogue.foundation.re.emp_dayoff.family: Give my best to your family.
dialogue.foundation.re.app_about.family: Do you have family in the village?
dialogue.foundation.re.app_why.dangerous: It's dangerous work. You know that?
breachprotocol.skill.administrator.descr: The Administrator's own. Use it and your body fights by itself, the way the great ones do: it hunts whatever you've marked hostile (anything coming for you first, then what it can see out in the open, never things hidden underground), flies to it and blinks onto it, strikes with SCP-096's blow, and throws your SCP powers and every Manas skill you hold, each when it's ready. Use it again to take yourself back.
breachprotocol.skill.shapeshift.descript: The Administrator's. Mimic mode: use it and become whatever you're looking at, creature or object, at once; crouch and use it to come back. Archive mode: use it to open the Archive of your forms (Polymorph for creatures, Mimic for objects), searchable; click one to become it, shift-click to be yourself again. A creature's form brings its skills with it.
